heading: Ntchito zomwe tsamba ili lingagwiritse ntchito
withdrawn: Zosankha zonse zachotsedwa. Ntchito iliyonse idzafunsanso.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Imawerengera maulendo ndi masamba owerengedwa. Google imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP ndipo ingaike makeke (cookies).
serviceSends_youtube: Imasewera makanema kuchokera ku YouTube. Google imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP ndipo ingaike makeke (cookies).
serviceSends_vimeo: Imasewera makanema kuchokera ku Vimeo. Vimeo imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP; tsamba ili limaipempha kuti isakutsatireni.
serviceSends_google_maps: Imaonetsa mapu kuchokera ku Google Maps. Google imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP ndipo ingaike makeke (cookies).
serviceSends_speech: Msakatuli wanu ukalephera kumvetsa mawu pa chipangizo chanu, mawu anu amapita ku ntchito yake yomvetsa mawu (Google, Apple kapena Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Imaonetsa makadi a repository ndi zinthu zina kuchokera ku GitHub. GitHub imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP ndipo ingaike makeke (cookies).
serviceSends_webstatus: Imaonetsa mabaji a Baseline othandizira msakatuli kuchokera ku webstatus.dev, pulojekiti ya Google Chrome. Google imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Imatsitsa laibulale ya A-Frame kuchokera ku aframe.io kuti iwonetse zithunzi za 3D. aframe.io imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP.
serviceSends_embed: Imaonetsa zinthu kuchokera ku {host}. {host} imalandira adilesi yanu ya IP ndipo ingaike makeke (cookies).
